tasks.title: Client brief to campaign plan
tasks.when: a client sends a brief and the team needs a first plan
steps: List what the client asks for, the deadline and the budget.
Write goal, audience, channels, three ideas and a timeline.
List every question the brief leaves open.

tasks.title: Post in the client's voice
tasks.when: a post is needed for a client's channel
steps: Read the client's voice notes and three past posts.
Write three variants of different length.
Mark which claims need the client's confirmation.
